A conjunction is an essential part of speech that we use to connect two sentences, clauses, phrases or words.

Let's take a look at some common conjunctions:

  • Although:

    • You use although to contrast ideas; it means despite the fact that. It is used at the beginning of a subordinate clause.

    Example:
    Although Swift is not as compatible as Java, it is becoming increasingly popular among new software developers.

  • But:

    • We use but to express contrast or a difference between two ideas.

    Example:
    SQL is used to handle huge amounts of information, but it doesn't need much coding.

  • Nevertheless:

    • This conjunction has a similar meaning to however . It introduces a contrasting idea to something that is mentioned before.

    Example:
    Managing an SQL database doesn't require lots of code. Nevertheless , interfacing an SQL database is much more complex.

  • Consequently:

    • It is used to show a cause-consequence relationship between two ideas. It is a synonym of therefore or as a result.

    Example:
    JavaScript is used to enhance how interactive a web page is. Consequently, it is a commonplace in user-friendly websites.

If and unless are conjunctions that you use to introduce conditional sentences.

You can use if to introduce situations or conditions and their results. Take a look at the following examples:

  • If a company needs to deal with huge amounts of information, it is necessary to hire a developer with experience and knowledge of SQL.
  • The web site needs JavaSript if you want it to be user-friendly.

The conjunction unless means if not or except if. The structure you use with unless is similar to the structure with if. The examples below are the same sentences rewritten with unless instead of if:

  • Unless a company needs to deal with huge amounts of information, it is not necessary to hire a developer with experience and knowledge of SQL.
  • The web site doesn't need JavaSript unless you want it to be user-friendly.
Consequently, if you are thinking of becoming a developer, it is important to get to know the most popular programming languages.
If you want to become a web developer, you should have a good knowledge of programming using JavaScript.
Its popularity with developers is undeniable because thousands of websites and applications will not work unless you install Java.
Functional language review, basic sentence patterns

If you are learning a foreign language, in this case English, it is common to have problems when it comes to writing formal or academic papers. Let's take a look at a very useful tip for making simple sentences in English.

Every sentence in English needs at least a subject and a verb in order to express a complete idea. In some languages, such as Spanish or Italian, this is not always necessary as the subject can be omitted because it is implicit.

Nowadays, many lucrative in-demand jobs require programming skills. Consequently, if you are thinking of becoming a developer, it is important to get to know the most popular programming languages.</br>
SQL</br>
SQL, which stands for Structured Query Language, is a programming language you use to design database technologies that power from small businesses to banks or universities. Actually, almost every person with access to technology uses SQL. Although it is a powerful language for doing simple to complex tasks, it does not require massive amounts of code.</br></br>

Java</br>
Java is a very popular programming language you use to produce software for multiple platforms. This is due to its compiled code which can run on most operating systems without compilation. Its syntax comes from the C and C++ programming languages. Its popularity with developers is undeniable because thousands of websites and applications will not work unless you install Java. Also, all original Android® apps used this language to develop their apps. Nevertheless, Java is not available on all platforms, and it will not run on older ones, so it will be a problem for institutions with no sufficient funds for software or hardware upgrades. </br></br>

JavaScript	</br>
This is one of the most popular programming languages right now, but do not confuse with Java. You commonly use JavaScript to add visual effects to web pages or display pop-up messages. If you want to become a web developer, you should have a good knowledge of programming using JavaScript. This language is a great tool to generate a great user interface by making web pages highly interactive and responsive.</br>
Although we don't intend for this list to be extensive, it gives an insight into the most popular programming languages that tech employers are looking for.
